newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka gets World Bank credit for power project.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka gets World Bank credit for power project.

text.p: The World Bank said in a statement on Thursday that it has agreed to give a $24.2 million credit to Sri Lanka for an alternative energy services delivery project.
The statement said a further $5.9 grant will be made available from the Global Environement Facility (GEF).
The project will encourage the use of environmentally-sound renewable technologies and reduce long term demand for electricity, the statement said.

It said the total project costs are estimated at $55.3 million. The $24.2 million IDA credit, made on standard terms, with 40 years maturity and a 10-year grace period, will finance 44 percent of the project cost, it added.
The remaining cost will be met through the GEF grant, private sector, participating credit institutions and the Sri Lankan government, the statement said.
